result: Authorized all-targets clippy PASS; both bounded source audits find no source defect or unintended performance-gate activation. Source/frozen evidence unchanged; live CI execution not observed in this task.

discovery.finding: Exactly one new leg, features overlay-deleted-projections, test:true; no tier override.

Fragment glob loads this entry; absent tier defaults to test, retained on PR/merge-group test tier. Selected mode keeps legs whose crate is in affected closure; other/malformed selection fails closed to full. Grouping preserves exact leg name/test/features. Root must verify actual selected artifact contains core/new leg; source registration alone does not prove execution.

Selected matrix and metadata artifacts emitted with same selection arguments as grouped matrix. GROUP_LEGS reaches run_leg; test:true performs cargo test after build, then clippy --all-targets. Each result records failed_step; any leg failure makes coarse group fail.

Normal workflow_run reporter uses default-branch code and validates artifact head against server workflow_run head. It uses run-specific selected artifact, so a new PR leg need not already be in default-branch fragments. Schema/completeness/duplicate checks precede reporting; name becomes opt-in <name>, success iff failed_step null. No static aggregator allowlist addition needed.

ci-summary queries all check-runs on exact PR/merge-group SHA. These per-leg/group/report names have no advisory-registry declaration or platform-advisory exemption, so their nonpassing results gate. Draft gate has distinct name and does not authorize admission.

A real opt-in group makes feature-matrix report structurally required. Normal production correlation binds report external_id to latest group run ID from details_url. Missing/non-success report cannot pass aggregate. Existing legacy no-ID and zero-leg handling remains unchanged, not redesigned in this task.

root_live_evidence_to_inspect: Exact feature-matrix head/event/attempt and successful selector/setup; selected-matrix artifact contains name sparq-core (overlay-deleted-projections), crate sparq-core, exact feature and test:true. Group number is dynamically packed: derive it from that run, never guess it.

Open that opt-in group log section headed opt-in sparq-core (overlay-deleted-projections): observe cargo build, nonzero executed test counts (including deletion projection tests), and all-targets clippy, all successful. Group success alone is insufficient detail.
Matching feature-matrix-results-<job-index> artifact has schema feature-matrix-group-results/v1 and exactly one row for new leg with failed_step:null; preserve actual group result.

Trusted reporter workflow_run identifies same triggering run/head; completeness passes and per-leg exact check succeeds; feature-matrix report is success with external_id equal to current group run ID. Inspect reporter failure/permission errors rather than inferring success from coarse job.

ci-summary aggregates those current exact-head checks. A draft-tier result is additional validation only; normal ready_for_review/full and merge-group evidence remain root-owned. No manual check fabrication, dispatch or hold bypass.
opt_in_required_check_audit.limits: No live checks/logs/API or assembler/test execution performed in this audit. Existing reporter and aggregator unchanged from baseline; this verifies source wiring, not future CI completion.

intentional_feature_on_gates.finding: Dedicated opt-in build/test/all-targets clippy explicitly enables it as requested.

These whole-workspace correctness/documentation gates intentionally enable all core features, including the experiment. They are separate jobs/Cargo invocations from default-state perf/memory/wasm measurements; no exclusion needed.

performance_feature_audit.no_implicit_activation_conclusion: No inspected gating performance/wasm-size/memory build knowingly enables the experimental feature. No new threshold, baseline edit, exception, gate weakening, source correction or blanket audit follows.
performance_feature_audit.limits: Source/build-command audit only; not a measured feature graph or successful artifact-size/perf result. CI must provide clean actual artifacts. Local opt-in benchmark evidence remains diagnostic, never a default-state gate or admission claim.
